_source: Star Citizen game files via StarBreaker
_assumptions: totals.byStateEstimate: per power state, the sum over the stock loadout's components (items in game-ship-components) of the resource-network Power and Coolant consumption (powerDraw, coolantDraw) and the EM / IR nominalSignature (em, ir). Every stock part is assumed to be in that state at once: Online is every part in its Online state (its first state when it has no Online, e.g. Idle); another key (Travelling, Transiting, ...) switches the parts that record that state to it and keeps the rest as in Online, and is left out when its sums equal Online's. How the game combines the parts (power allocation, signature falloff) is not stated.

fireParts: the stock radars, power plants, coolers, shields, quantum and jump drives, life support, batteries, fuel and quantum fuel tanks, missiles and bombs that game-fire lists with a health pool (MCsim build_fire.py's slots).

flight.boost.durationEstimate: seconds a full boost capacitor lasts, afterburnerNew.capacitorMax / capacitorAfterburnerIdleCost. Assumes the idle cost is the whole drain (capacitorAfterburnerLinearCost and AngularCost are 0 on nearly every controller and are not added), that the capacitor does not regenerate while boosting, and that boosting stops at an empty capacitor rather than at afterburnerCapacitorThresholdRatio.
